rationale: Public reporting documented a vacant former commercial building in 2021; a Jan 2025 listing still calls the existing restaurant/market vacant. A 57-unit redevelopment was proposed, but no source located confirms it was built or occupied. The evidence supports vacancy through Jan 2025, not continuous vacancy or present occupancy in Oct 2026; status and total duration remain unknown.
vacancy_duration: Observed vacant in Sep 2021 and Jan 2025; continuous duration and status after Jan 2025 unknown

evidence.details: Identifies APN 001-0209-015-00 and describes current use as Vacant Restaurant and Market; existing single-story commercial building. Listing now says no longer advertised.
Reports existing single-story commercial structure was vacant and slated for demolition for proposed housing.

evidence.source_name: City of Oakland Appendix C: Sites Inventory
evidence.details: PLN21175 at the matching APN/address is Approved-Pending Appeal for 57 units with expected completion 2025-12-31; planning pipeline entry does not establish completion or occupancy.

evidence.source_name: Stanley Saitowitz / Natoma Architects project page
evidence.details: Describes proposed 55-home project and design imagery; no completion date or occupancy evidence.
